# Security policy

This policy covers every WithMarfa repository that does not have its own.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of each repository receives security fixes. If you use an older release, update to the latest one and check whether the problem is still there.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report a vulnerability in a public issue, discussion or pull request.

Report it privately with the **Report a vulnerability** button on the **Security** tab of the affected repository. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and what someone could do with it.

## After you report

We acknowledge your report and keep you informed while we investigate and fix it, until the fix is released.
